thread:
maya: Heads up — deploybot just flagged SBOM/vuln noise on rc-2026. Need clarity on delegated approvals during the change window. @kevin @anna please advise.

deploybot: SCAN RESULT rc-2026
- low: 3 (license noise)
- medium: 1 (transitive pkg-foo@1.2.3)
Gate: manual review required. Link: https://artifacts/internal/rc-2026/sbom

anna: I'll take a first pass on the findings. Quick thought — can we delegate approval for low-severity license noise to the SRE lead during the 8am-10am PT change window so we don't stall rollout? :thinking_face:

kevin: Delegation sounds fine if we have an audit trail. If SRE approves, require them to add a short note in the release notes: "delegated approval by SRE lead — rationale: low severity / known FP" and reference the artifact SHA. Also capture who approved in deploy metadata.

sam: I can cover that slot today. Quick question: what's our rollback threshold? If the medium transitive CVE persists after canary, do we auto-rollback or do mitigation/hotpatch first?

anna: For that medium transitive CVE, Security recommends mitigation first unless exploitability >= 7 or it's in a security-critical path. Proposal: allow medium transitive <=6 with a mitigation plan noted in the release notes; require rollback if exploitability >=7 or if canary shows functional/regression impact.

jen: From Legal: license noise doesn't require legal block if the license is already on the procurement-approved list. Please include a license_whitelist tag in the SBOM note to speed reviews.

maya: Action items so we have a clear path: 
1) SRE delegation for low noise with a short release-note template entry.
2) Clarify rollback rule (exploitability>=7 OR failed_canary -> rollback).
3) Deploybot to add approval metadata to PRs and release artifacts. @deploybot, can you attach approved_by + approval_reason to the artifact metadata?

deploybot: yes — will add fields to artifact metadata: 
```
approved_by: "<display-name>"
approval_reason: "<short rationale>"
approval_ts: "<iso-ts>"
rollback_hint: "rollback_if: exploitability>=7 || failed_canary==true"
```
Example: approved_by: "sam", approval_reason: "minor license noise - whitelisted"

kevin: Also please surface a concise `release_note_section` to include in the changelog that states the delegation and mitigation plan. We want a single line per artifact for auditing.

sam: I pushed a brief README snippet for the release-note template — PTAL: https://go/release-notes-template (internal). I'll be on-call 8-10am PT and will approve low-noise items that match the whitelist.

maya: Great. I'll update the release checklist and notify the PMs. If anyone objects to the delegation/rollback rule, raise before 10am PT or we'll proceed with today's canary.

anna: No objections from Security. We'll monitor canary metrics and escalate if anything anomalous appears.

jen: Legal ack — ping me if a license outside the whitelist appears and we'll triage.

maya: Thanks all — deploying canary in 15. I'll post final artifact SHA here after deploy. :rocket:
